tagline: Remote engineering teams for product companies.
summary: Leading architecture and delivery of Readable English — a cross-platform Flutter reading app with on-device speech recognition and AI-generated learning content.
highlights: Architected and led the Flutter app across iOS, Android and Web.
Shipped fully on-device speech recognition with sherpa-onnx on all three platforms, using a memory-optimised local model for fast STT.
Developed a text-matching algorithm that accurately detects which words of a passage have been spoken, powering real-time reading feedback.
Built multiple games on this engine for decoding, vocabulary building and fluency (Falling Words, Vocab Vault, Space Race).
Set up an AI pipeline that generates app content matched to each learner’s Lexile and reading grade level.
Wired up Firebase Remote Config, Analytics and Crashlytics, and shipped in-app subscriptions.

tagline: India’s B2B agri-trade marketplace for mandi traders.
summary: Involved from day one — led Bijak’s move from native to Flutter and a team of 8 building the Bijak app and the Just Fresh family of apps.
highlights: Led the migration from native Android to Flutter while continuing to ship features.
Built B2B (Bijak) and D2C (Just Fresh) products end-to-end — 600K+ downloads combined.
Chose Flutter 3 with GetX and MVVM to build fast with a consistent architecture.
Led a team of 8 engineers, coordinating with design, product and marketing.
Built the Just Fresh apps — customer, delivery & logistics and warehouse admin — with 80% shared code.
Automated build, test and release with CI/CD (Codemagic).
Integrated analytics and engagement tooling (Segment, MoEngage, Branch) to measure and optimise funnels.
Trained TensorFlow models and introduced Gen AI tooling to cut manual work in internal processes.
